title: Multi-line list item (Shift+Enter) persists after save and reopen — client note
preconditions: You are on a client's Close page with access to Client Info › Notes. Regression coverage for WMD-1920: a second line inside a list item used to be dropped on save, collapsing the item to one line on reopen.

steps.action: Open the Client Info modal → Notes tab, then click 'Add' (or 'Open' on an existing note) to open the note editor.
Start a numbered or bulleted list and type text in the first list item.
steps.expected_result: A list item is created with the typed text and the correct bullet/number marker.

steps.action: Press Shift+Enter inside that same list item to start a second line, then type text on it (or paste a screenshot so the image sits on its own line under the bullet).
steps.expected_result: The second line/image appears on its own line within the same list item; the list marker is not repeated for the soft-break line.

steps.action: Wait for the note to auto-save, then close the note editor and the Client Info modal.
steps.expected_result: The note saves without error and the modal closes.

The list item still shows both lines as separate lines (the second line/image on its own line under the bullet); the content is NOT collapsed to a single line, not merged into the preceding sentence, and the text stays styled as a list.
